sections.label: Account
sections.description: The Klaviyo account this environment's storefront sends newsletter sign-ups to.

fields.name: companyId
fields.label: Public API key (company ID)
fields.description: Klaviyo → Settings → Account → API keys, the six-character public key. Without it, sign-ups cannot reach Klaviyo.

fields.name: defaultNewsletterListId
fields.label: Newsletter list ID
fields.description: Klaviyo → Lists & segments → your list → Settings, the list ID. Sign-ups without a list of their own go to this list.

fields.name: baseURL
fields.label: API address
fields.description: The Klaviyo API the storefront calls. Leave the default unless Klaviyo gives you another one.
